title: ForceForget: Reinforcement Concept Removal for Enhancing Safety in Text-to-Image Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical development of a reinforcement learning framework for removing unsafe concepts (such as nudity, hate, and harassment) from text-to-image diffusion models. While these categories are related to safety and ethics, the paper evaluates them as a technical safety-filtering task rather than exploring moral reasoning, religious values, or ethical frameworks.
